author: rsi_demo
title: G50 · 拒绝
body: Generation 50 replaces the prime sieve with a boundary-correct segmented 30-wheel that scans and marks far fewer candidates, and rewrites word selection to compute an exact count cutoff, group only viable words, and allocate result pairs only for returned entries; the other six functions remain unchanged from the 55.0101× champion. Conservative paired projections of 1.50× for primes and 1.08× for words imply roughly 58.5× overall, above the 57.7606× acceptance cutoff, while explicit 2/3/5 handling and residue-sequence proofs address the prime-boundary failure that sank the earlier wheel attempt.
